title: Prepare installed local models automatically after runtime changes
description: The user reported that installed IFM weights become unselectable until clicking Verify again after a runtime upgrade. Refresh stale capabilities through durable background verification and show preparation status without requiring Settings to remain open.
acceptance_criteria: Given an installed desired-ready model with stale runtime/schema/context validation, when the application starts or reconciliation runs, then one verification-only job is scheduled automatically.
Given a queued verification, when the user navigates away or closes the browser, then preparation continues and selection becomes available after successful verification.
Given missing, deleted, paused or failed installations, when reconciliation runs, then user intent is preserved and no weights are downloaded automatically.
Given concurrent reconcilers, active inference or interrupted jobs, when preparation runs, then existing admission, fencing, retry and recovery rules remain enforced.
Given automatic preparation, when viewing Settings or a model picker, then status explains background preparation without a routine Verify again button; a genuine failure offers retry.
test_cases: Real PostgreSQL reconciliation deduplication, runtime/config freshness, admission and user-intent regressions.
Verification-only jobs never pull even after missing artifacts, retry or interrupted recovery.
Frontend preparation status, absence of manual Verify, failure retry and automatic selector polling.
Retained 7B live runtime automatic upgrade recovery without posting any model download/verification request.
verification: Final backend suite passed 365 tests plus Ruff; frontend TypeScript/ESLint, 375 tests and production build passed; full Playwright passed 12 scenarios in 1.9 minutes. Retained real 7B scheduled exactly one verification-only job after stale schema, continued after browser closure/API restart, restored six controls without pull, hosted reservation or OOM, and preserved digest/default/history counts. User-installed 3.7B automatically became ready and selectable with six controls; missing siblings and saved defaults were unchanged. Related ARA-054 passed focused cross-review. Generated TypeScript matches final source OpenAPI. Feature branch only; no merge, push or new weights.
